en: Added a progress heartbeat every 30 seconds while hooks run long in `claude -p` and SDK sessions, so a host such as Claude Desktop won't end the turn as hung (once it includes this version)
zh: 在 `claude -p` 和 SDK session 中 hooks 长时间运行时，每 30 秒发送一次进度心跳，避免 Claude Desktop 等宿主将本轮判定为挂起而结束（待其包含此版本后生效）
